He is very calm in his kennel. Once you get him outside in a play lot with toys, he is such a happy boy. He loves running around with his toy in his mouth. Both times I’ve walked him. He has not had a messy candle. He seems to wait to go outside.
Super sweet. Definitely needs to put on weight and start feeling better before we can see her full personality. She was very receptive to being around humans and checked in regularly.
He was a little ham, just flopped on the ground and asked for belly rubs! Liked treats and toys and watching the other pups. Snuggly and playful. Smaller with a little puppy energy.
Beefcake is an athlete! This big boy can run! He LOVES to play fetch with any and all toys. He knows drop & will drop near your feet for next toss. Has the cutest sploot when he's resting.

Bunny is so skinny right now so she is just focused on snacks- which I gladly let her sample them all. Her tail is always wagging and she has a wonderful smile. Can't wait to see her at a healthier weight!

Brand new, still adjusting. Sweet Buttercrisp is unsure of shelter chaos. Small wounds healing on head so going very slow when leashing helps her. Likes to do lots of sniffing. She ate treat tosses and got the courage to take them very gently from my hand. She was also brave enough to sit nearby me in the quiet little lots by sheds.

She’s really good at playing fetch. She will run after the toy and bring it back and exchange the toy for a treat. She seemed to be a quick learner.

Sweetest girl ever! All she wanted was to lean up and cuddle on me. Was very neutral/friendly towards other dogs and was overall a calm dog. I think you could put her in any family, and she would win their hearts over.

Cynara is still adjusting to shelter life, maybe a holder. Easy to walk, checks in, gentle with treats. Likes sniffing & observing. She warms up once she knows you are a friend & will sit closer to show you her beautiful smile. Total leg leaner by the end, loved spending slow quiet time with her!
Treats, Toys, Cuddling/close handler contact, Sniffing / Exploring

Fun high energy little man! He walks on a leash like a little turbo car. Just wants to zoom around. Super sweet and definitely seemed like he would be a cuddler, but just a little too high strung in the shelter. Great dog and an overall little love bug.
Treats, Cuddling/close handler contact, Sniffing / Exploring
Very sweet boy, climbed in my lap to cuddle, not too interested in toys but loves treats and sniffing

Dirk is a handsome beefcake. He's a shy guy in a scary shelter. The trucks on the street were scary too. Takes treats very gently but needs a few minutes to warm up before he asks for cuddles. His tail was wagging as he tried to lick the dog next door through the slit at the end of the gate- easy to call away.
Treats, Cuddling/close handler contact, Sniffing / Exploring

Really sweet girl. Wanted to cuddle and be close. Really loved seeing other dogs and was excited and happy. She might be mixed with a pug or another short-nosed breed bc it seems like she has some respiratory problems that would be common in a pug breed.

She can be a little excited with her mouth when she gets excited
Treats, Cuddling/close handler contact, Sniffing / Exploring

Dunlap doesn't seem bothered by the knocking in his leg. Knows sit, paw & other paw. Loves working his skills & cute face for treats. Likes chasing after a few toys. Also probably a holder as he had 6 HUGE poops & peed several times for several minutes staight. Poor guy.
Treats, Cuddling/close handler contact, Sniffing / Exploring

Elm is small and easy to walk. He's playful and loves smushy cuddles. He seemed a little itchy and allowed brushing all over. He loves taking pics, working his puppy dog eyes& head tilt. Prefers that you break his treats into little pieces please. Super adorable fun boy!
English Muffin is a sweet girl with drooly jowls. She's pretty sick right now - we did slow walking so she could sneeze/cough the ick out. Takes treats very very gently & knows sit. Such a nice girl!
Treats, Cuddling/close handler contact, Sniffing / Exploring
When she saw other dogs it made her so happy! she would get a burst of energy and have a mini-zoomie!

Hobart did well with a corporate group of about 12. He starts a little shy but warms up fast. He enjoyed leaning into several people for pets. He showed off his super cute tippy toe tap dance for everyone too. He loves sitting for treats. Several people commented on how beautiful his coat is! His ears were bothering him & confirmed with Sia he's on meds for ear infection. - right ear especially sensitive right now. Sweet sweet boy!
Hobart is super sweet young boy. Loves sitting for snacks & doing tippy toe tap dance! No toy interest right now, Little jumpy- worked on "find it" and rewarding sits. Good improvement.
Treats, Cuddling/close handler contact, Toys, Pacing / Owner Searching

Unsure about the slip lead going over head initially but easy to do with a treat. Gentle treat taker. Paced the fence a bit when we first went out but then settled to smell. Shaking head, seemingly his ears are bothering him & he had discharge from them. Likes squeaky toys. Takes a second to warm up but gets goofy. A little nervous/hesitant to walk in open spaces (ex between yards) but more confident inside or in yard/run. Easy to kennel with treat toss. Big time leaner in for cuddles.
Hubbard is easy to walk, takes treats gently, knows sit/paw, loves rolling in the grass & just lounging. On meds now. Very nice boy!

Katisha is a doll. Confused by her shelter digs & looking for anything familiar. She knows sit & takes treats gently. Comes out of kennel talking to her neighbors. Likes to chase birds & the loud trucks were scary but recovers quickly. Gives little kisses.
Very much a puppy! Will get little bursts of energy but then want to cuddle near you. I think she would be great in a household with dogs or kids. She really seemed like she would enjoying playing.

Linden seems very young as starts off little jumpy/mouthy to communicate but easily takes redirection. Eager to learn. Knows sit, gentle mouth. Loves zoomies & tennis balls. Can self entertain w/ball and flops his body all around. Climbs chairs for snacks. Fun boy good match for active family.

Michelin never met a toy he didn’t like! Great at self-entertaining but also will trade for a treat. Fun energetic puppy!

Michelin is very skinny so snacks are his priority- has a great sit. Front left paw seemed wonky-sent vet check as he would hold it up while sitting & not for paw. Seemed fine walking on it. Seemed to display friendly interest in other dogs. Handsome boy!

Very sweet girl, loves affection and playing fetch

Loved playing ball, has tons of energy and played fetch with the large balls for 25 minutes straight. It did help tire her out though because she didn’t pull nearly as bad after. Has a great sit and takes treats very gently
Treats, Toys, Cuddling/close handler contact, Playing fetch/chasing ball, Sniffing / Exploring
Penguin is easy to walk, loves to sniff in yard & lot. He's still adjusting, starts off shy but definitely warms up after a few minutes. Takes treats very gently and even gives little kisses.
Treats, Toys, Durable chews/bones, Cuddling/close handler contact, Playing fetch/chasing ball, Sniffing / Exploring
He’s a baby angel. If you’re sitting, he’ll want to come up in your lap and give you kisses. Such a sweet boy who is a big cuddly love bug.
Treats, Pool/water play, Toys, Sniffing / Exploring

Very sweet. I think she’s still very new to the shelter and settling in. Wasn’t a huge fan of cuddles or pets. Seemed like she was scared and wary, but very sweet and seemed more confident around other dogs.
Very sweet boy. Seemed interested in other dogs. Just not feeling too well at the moment.
Can get a little excited when taking treats
Spritzer is a fun senior. Loves to play fetch and also self entertains with balls. Drops for next toss or treats. Great sit and takes snacks nicely.
Treats, Sniffing / Exploring, Pacing / Owner Searching

Thaddeus is still adjusting to shelter chaos. He may be a holder. Lots of pacing in lot. He did warm up enough to take some jerky treats. Barked at corporate volunteers refilling poop bags but was able to disengage. Poor guy just seems scared & overwhelmed. Going slow and giving him space to just "be" hopefully will help him to relax a bit.

Tobey is confused by his new shelter reality. He chased a few tennis balls but liked sniffing around. No toy or treat interest right now. Showed me his sit & liked climbing the bridge too. Chased birds in the lot. Very cute boy that seems well fed.
Very sweet boy! Was alert towards other dogs and would bark. Recommend showing him to adopters in a quieter area!
Holder. Might have prey drive. Very sweet!

Winona was all about the toys and solo play! But she would engage and chase me and would drop her ball for another high value toy! She would take breaks and just lay and chew on her ball at a distance from me. No pets or treats but we had fun!

Wyler is soft & sweet. He's sick right now so we just slow walked around so he could cough out the ick.Allows handling all over & I brushed him out which he really seemed to enjoy. He did lots of rolling in the straw and has a great sploot too. Mostly just wanted cuddles.
It took her a while to warm up. She’s got excited seeing other dogs
Sweet girl with horribly cropped ears. Skinny and likes treats.
